title: FlexPass
shortDescription: Pay-per-use microservices marketplace with unified wallet, Redis distributed locking, and Groq AI integrations.
description: Architected a pay-per-use marketplace with a unified wallet and Razorpay integration, supporting 5+ digital service types with time- and usage-based access control over a modular Node.js/Express backend.
problem: Traditional SaaS models lock users into inflexible recurring subscriptions even when they only need intermittent access to digital tools, leading to wasted spend and high drop-off rates.
solution: Built a unified pay-as-you-go microservice wallet that meters usage in real-time with atomic balance deductions and distributed locking to completely eliminate race conditions.
features: Unified multi-service wallet with Razorpay payment gateway integration
Redis-based distributed locking & token bucket rate limiting (cutting unauthorized attempts by 80%)
Triple authentication pipeline: JWT, Google OAuth 2.0, and Email OTP verification
Real-time analytics dashboard with Recharts for revenue tracking and system health monitoring
5% automated cashback engine and double-sided referral mechanism
Live support chat with Groq AI-powered service recommendations
metrics: 80% reduction in unauthorized attempts • 60% fewer invalid session errors

title: JobGrid
shortDescription: AI-powered engineering job aggregation portal serving 500+ daily users across web and mobile.
description: Engineered an AI-powered job portal for software engineering roles aggregating listings from 10+ sources via automated scrapers, a Telegram bot, and cron-scheduled ingestion pipelines.
problem: Job listings are fragmented across dozens of career boards with inconsistent formats, obscure tech stack requirements, and spam postings that waste candidate hours.
solution: Developed an automated aggregation platform that parses unstructured postings using Groq (LLaMA 3) NLP into structured metadata, seniority levels, and tech stacks with real-time push alerts.
features: Multi-source automated scraper & Telegram bot pipeline with cron-scheduled background ingestion
Groq (LLaMA 3) NLP parsing to extract tech stacks, seniority levels, and compensation metadata
Smart faceted filters by graduation batch, seniority, tech stack, and employment type
Real-time hiring market analytics dashboard visualizing demand trends using Recharts
Community discussion forum and admin moderation console with automated spam quarantine
Cross-platform mobile app built with Capacitor supporting native push notifications
metrics: 500+ daily active users • 10+ aggregated job sources • Real-time NLP parsing

title: WhereIsMyBitBus
shortDescription: Real-time campus transit telemetry platform serving 300+ daily commuters at BIT Mesra.
description: Built a real-time bus tracking platform (React, JavaScript, Firebase) solving daily transit uncertainty for 300+ students and staff at BIT Mesra.
problem: Campus transit schedules at BIT Mesra were unpredictable, resulting in hundreds of students waiting at stops with zero visibility into bus location or delays.
solution: Created a lightweight real-time transit telemetry map that streams driver GPS coordinates directly to student devices with sub-5-second latency using OpenStreetMap and Firebase.
features: Live bus tracking on interactive OpenStreetMap with 98% spatial accuracy
5-second real-time coordinate streaming optimized to minimize database write volume
Driver location broadcasting portal with low-battery GPS wake-lock mode
Firebase Authentication for secure student access across campus domains
Route overview with stop arrival estimates and delay alerts
metrics: 300+ campus users • 98% live location accuracy • 5-second coordinate streaming

title: Cryp2Sale
shortDescription: Global cryptocurrency merchandise and products e-commerce platform with 100+ daily international users.
description: A global e-commerce platform focused on cryptocurrency products, trusted by over 100+ daily international users for secure and seamless transactions, offering an intuitive and user-friendly shopping experience.
problem: Crypto enthusiasts lacked a streamlined, reliable portal to purchase authentic hardware wallets and merchandise using diverse payment gateways.
solution: Delivered a fully responsive commerce experience with secure payment processing, inventory tracking, and localized checkout workflows.
features: International shopping cart and checkout architecture
Integrated multi-currency payment gateways including cryptocurrency checkout
Optimized product catalog with instant search and category filtering
SEO-optimized product pages and automated order tracking

title: Frontend Code Editor
shortDescription: In-browser live code editor providing real-time HTML, CSS, and JavaScript preview for 100+ active coders.
description: An interactive frontend code editor that enables real-time HTML, CSS, and JavaScript preview. The tool has received positive feedback from over 100 users, supporting their coding practice sessions.
problem: Setting up local dev environments and bundlers introduces friction for students practicing UI prototyping and learning web development.
solution: Engineered an in-browser sandbox with sandboxed iframe rendering, live state synchronisation, and syntax highlighting.
features: Real-time synchronized execution of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Sandboxed iframe execution protecting against DOM leaks
Code snippet sharing and session export
Customizable editor layout and themes
metrics: 100+ active practice coders • Real-time instant rendering

title: Leetcode-Replica
shortDescription: Hackathon-winning algorithm testing platform with real-time code editor and instant test case validation.
description: A web-based platform inspired by LeetCode, built for practicing coding problems interactively. It features algorithm challenges, a real-time code editor, and instant solution validation. Created during a hackathon — and won.
problem: College coding communities needed a tailored platform for mock technical interviews with curated questions and instantaneous test-case evaluation.
solution: Developed a full-stack algorithm runner with multi-language test execution, leaderboard ranking, and question catalog.
features: Interactive code editing and test execution harness
Automated test case verification and execution time tracking
Dynamic leaderboard and user submission history
Won 1st Prize at university hackathon competition
metrics: Hackathon 1st Prize Winner • Live solution validation

title: Jeevandan
shortDescription: Academic resource sharing platform for BIT Mesra students with Telegram bot integration.
description: An intuitive online platform for BIT Mesra students, providing 50+ users easy access to a vast collection of study materials across different branches and academic years. Completed in just three weeks.
problem: Academic study materials at BIT Mesra were scattered across drives and chat groups with broken links and lost syllabus references.
solution: Centralized semester-wise notes, previous year question papers, and lab manuals with automated Telegram bot file delivery.
features: Branch- and semester-wise categorized repository of lecture notes & PYQs
Integrated Telegram bot for automated document downloads
Student upload review flow with verified contributor badges

shortDescription: Interactive number deduction game with attempt limits and dynamic feedback.

description: A simple and elegant Digital Clock web application built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. This project displays the current time in real-time with a clean and responsive interface.

shortDescription: Classic memory pattern game testing user visual and auditory sequence recall.
description: A fun and interactive Simon Says Game built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. This memory game challenges users to repeat a randomly generated sequence of button presses.
